name: mysocial-intelligence
description: See what works on your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, and what to post next.

interface.shortDescription: What works in your content, and what to post next
interface.longDescription: Social media intelligence from your own posts, transcripts, comments and audience on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Threads and Substack, plus the creators and outlier posts in your niche. On paid plans it also searches public posts on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X and Threads. Understand what works for you, what is working across social media, and what to make next. It reads and researches; it never posts for you.
defaultPrompt: Show me what is working in my content.
Tell me what is gaining momentum in my social world.
Use my social intelligence to plan my next post.
